name: System32 wermgr.exe Integrity Change (RoguePlanet LPE plant)
description: A protected System32 binary (wermgr.exe) is created/modified/renamed by a non-servicing/non-Defender process. Crux of the RoguePlanet Defender-remediation TOCTOU LPE.
query: file where event.action in ("creation","modification","rename","overwrite") and file.path : "?:\\Windows\\System32\\wermgr.exe*" and not process.executable : ("?:\\Windows\\servicing\\*","?:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\*","?:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\*") and not process.name : ("TiWorker.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe","MsMpEng.exe")
false_positives: Legitimate OS servicing outside the standard servicing path

name: MpClient.dll Loaded by Non-Defender Process (Defender remediation abuse)
description: MpClient.dll loaded by a process that is not part of Windows Defender. RoguePlanet drives MpScanStart/MpCleanStart from a user process to race the SYSTEM clean path.
query: library where dll.name : "MpClient.dll" and not process.executable : ("?:\\Program Files\\Windows Defender\\*","?:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\*") and not process.name : ("MsMpEng.exe","MpCmdRun.exe","NisSrv.exe","smartscreen.exe")
false_positives: Security tooling that wraps the Defender management API

name: WER wermgr.exe Spawns Interactive SYSTEM Console (RoguePlanet payoff)
description: wermgr.exe running as SYSTEM spawns an interactive console (conhost/cmd/powershell). The WER QueueReporting task runs the planted wermgr.exe as SYSTEM, opening an interactive SYSTEM console.
query: process where event.type == "start" and process.parent.name : "wermgr.exe" and process.name : ("conhost.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe") and user.name : ("SYSTEM","NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM")

name: ISO Stage + Junction Race by Non-Elevated Process (RoguePlanet staging)
description: A process stages/mounts an ISO and manipulates NTFS junctions around a Defender operation — supporting signal of the RoguePlanet remediation race.
query: any where (event.category == "process" and process.command_line : ("*AttachVirtualDisk*","*Mount-DiskImage*","*\\RP_*")) or (event.category == "file" and file.path : "*\\RP_*" and file.extension : "iso")
false_positives: Legitimate ISO mounting by deployment tooling
